objective: Make every labelled unit carry the identity of the bar it was derived from. (C) build_bar_matrix.py stamps lt_id / trace_id / bar_open_ts / engine_state_after / trace_join_status, inherited from the layer-trace L3 rows of ONE lt_id filtered out of the shared results/layer_trace/XAUUSD_layer_trace.jsonl (323,294 rows, 9 run_ids measured 2026-09-22). --lt-id is now MANDATORY (never auto-picks the latest run) unless --no-trace-join. (C2) crt_state_resolved is renamed ontology_state (CRTStateResolver's declarative label) and engine_state_after is added (the CRT engine's own curr_state, read from the L3 output_hash) -- two DIFFERENT quantities per F-069 that must never share a column name again; both names reused verbatim from runtime/crt_construction_trace.py, which already emits exactly these two producer-qualified fields. (D) the oracle labeler (src/research/oracle/labeler.py) INHERITS lt_id / trace_id / bar_open_ts from the matrix by row index -- no new id is minted -- and its own run_id column is renamed label_run_id (a differently-scoped id from lt_id: the labeling invocation vs the spine walk). New invariant I8 (label_trace_resolution) in src/governance/identity_chain.py verifies the join: every label row's (lt_id, bar_open_ts) resolves to an L3 row under that SAME lt_id, trace_id's embedded timestamp agrees with the row's own bar_open_ts, and the file carries exactly one lt_id. Fail-closed readers fixed in the SAME commit: src/research/oracle/scan.py, scripts/research/oracle_pattern_scan.py, scripts/research/validate_oracle_harness.py all read crt_state_resolved with a tolerant `if extra in df.columns`, which under the rename would silently drop the resolver stratum from every downstream scan -- the exact F-056/F-079/F-083/F-085 silent-gap class this change closes elsewhere. Identity only: no trading decision, no trade math, no cost model, no label VALUE changes -- proved by a byte-identity test on label values and on ontology_state values (with vs without the identity columns), not merely asserted. This closes only the JOIN precondition -- the three parity contracts (cost model / tie-break / stop geometry) from the originating thread remain separate, unstarted, unscoped work.
